text:
rajesh: Quick sync — proposal to cut down the handoff API to two headers and a tiny control endpoint. Reason: keep proxy cheap and self-contained.

olivia: ok do you mean we remove the big rpc and only use signed tokens + client hints?

rajesh: yep. headers:
- X-RW-Region-Hint: resident=eu|any|soft
- X-RW-Handoff-Token: v1;kid=...;sig=...;nonce=...

mari: token lifecycle? rotation? private deployments need BYOK.

rajesh: plan:
1) tokens issued by control plane KMS, rotatable via admin API
2) default TTL 45s, single-use; private can enable allow_long_lived_handoff_tokens=true with RBAC
3) audit events emitted with token id, operator id

stefan: 45s feels small if warmup needs N nodes. Backpressure strategy?

rajesh: proxy & runtime handle staged warmup + queueing. control plane responds 202 queued or 200 prewarm-ack. Retries: proxy will retry with backoff; tokens valid for extended retry budget (45s + 3 retries over 3m) but single-use enforced by nonce store in hosted; private can opt out.

olivia: residency enforcement? strict vs soft semantics?

rajesh: strict -> reject with 451 and X-RW-Fallback: none. soft -> allow fallback but include X-RW-Fallback: region=us-west;reason=latency

mari: needs audit trail retention 30d and minimal PII. Also we need rotate endpoint docs.

rajesh: noted.

infra-bot: checklist: endpoints must be authenticated, rate-limited, emit telemetry for token create/use/expire.

stefan: can we have a sample exchange?

rajesh: paste:

```
# client -> edge
X-RW-Region-Hint: resident=eu

# proxy -> control
X-RW-Handoff-Token: v1;kid=key123;nonce=abc123;sig=...

# control -> proxy
200 OK
X-RW-Handoff-State: PREWARM

# proxy -> client
451 Unavailable For Legal Reasons
X-RW-Fallback: policy=strict;reason=region_blocked
```

mari: security question: what algo for sig? RSASSA-PSS? HMAC?

rajesh: prefer AEAD signed tokens -> ECDSA for hosted, HSM-backed keys for private. We'll document choices and allow plugin.

olivia: ops: rollback path if prewarm fails mid-drain?

rajesh: yes state machine: PREWARM -> DRAIN -> COMMIT | ABORT. Abort reasons include prewarm_fail, operator_cancel. Rollback runbook will be added to runbook repo.

stefan: i'll implement proxy spike for queued handoffs and share perf numbers tomorrow.

mari: tagging @security-team for quick review.

rajesh: thanks all. I'll update RFC appendix and owners: control-plane impl (rajesh), KMS/rotation docs (mari), proxy backpressure (stefan), ops runbook (olivia). :thumbsup:
